extraction.notes: Net loss/FFO/Core FFO taken from the 3/31/2022 column of the FFO table (seq 19); cross-checked against the Core FFO reconciliation on seq 13. Zero-value lines (discontinued ops RE D&A, loss on extinguishment, loss on interest rate derivatives, insurance gain, leasing commissions, cash loss on extinguishment, share-based items at zero) omitted. AFFO table starts from NAREIT FFO (14,476), not Core FFO. The printed AFFO subtotal of 15,616 sits mid-list; it is not used as a total here, and the affo_adjustments run from NAREIT FFO straight to Core AFFO 17,980 (sum checks: 14,476 + 3,504 = 17,980). Core AFFO is the company's final AFFO-type metric. Company's AFFO subtotal is 15,616 (page 17). Transformation costs classified as severance_restructuring (strategic shift incl. consulting and termination benefits); this is a judgment call. Tenant improvements and amortization of lease intangibles classified as 'other'. Recurring capital improvements are already deducted in AFFO, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Allocation to participating securities (72) is not in the FFO-to-Core FFO chain and is excluded. Company reports no AFFO per-share figure. Diluted share count 87,253 is already in thousands and reproduces $0.17 (14,476/87,253) and $0.20 (17,173/87,253).
